_meta.note: Curated Proto-Semitic reconstructions for Biblical Hebrew and Talmudic Aramaic vocabulary

אב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *ʾab- 'father'. Cognate with Akkadian abu, Arabic ʾab.

אדם.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *ʾadam- 'man, human'. Related to √ʾdm 'to be red'.

קצר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qṣr 'to be short'. Also 'to harvest'.

חסד.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ḥsd 'kindness, loyalty'. Hebrew covenant term.

אמת.etymologyText: From √ʾmn 'to be firm, faithful'. Related to אמן.

אזל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ʾzl 'to go, depart'. Common Aramaic verb replacing Hebrew הלך.

הוה.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √hwy 'to be, become'. Aramaic cognate of Hebrew היה.

חד.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *ḥad- 'one'. Aramaic form; Hebrew uses אחד.

יהב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √yhb 'to give'. Aramaic verb replacing Hebrew נתן.

בר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *bar- 'son' (Aramaic). Hebrew uses בן from same root family.

יתב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √yṯb 'to sit, dwell'. Aramaic cognate of Hebrew ישב.

בעא.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √bʿy 'to seek, request'. Common Aramaic verb.

נפק.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √npq 'to go out'. Aramaic cognate of Hebrew יצא.

עלל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ʿll 'to enter'. Aramaic verb for 'enter' (Hebrew בוא).

סלק.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √slq 'to go up, ascend'. Common Aramaic verb.

נחת.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √nḥt 'to descend'. Aramaic cognate of Hebrew ירד.

חזא.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ḥzy 'to see'. Aramaic verb replacing Hebrew ראה.

שבק.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √šbq 'to leave, abandon'. Common Talmudic verb.

קדם.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qdm 'to be in front, precede'.

קבל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qbl 'to receive, accept'. Common in Rabbinic texts.

גמר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √gmr 'to complete, finish'. Key Talmudic term (גמרא).

תנא.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √tny 'to repeat, teach'. Source of תנא 'Tanna'.

פשט.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √pšṭ 'to spread out, explain'. Source of פשט (plain meaning).

דרש.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √drš 'to seek, inquire'. Source of דרש, מדרש.

הלכ.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √hlk 'to walk, go'. Source of הלכה 'halakha'.

אגד.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ʾgd 'to bind, tell'. Source of אגדה 'aggadah'.

פרק.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √prq 'to divide, separate'. Source of פרק 'chapter'.

מלל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √mll 'to speak'. Poetic/Aramaic for דבר.

צלי.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ṣly 'to pray'. Source of תפילה through semantic development.

קלל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qll 'to be light; to curse'. Opposite of כבד.

דין.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √dyn 'to judge'. Source of דין, דיין.

חטא.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ḥṭʾ 'to miss, sin'. Primary Hebrew word for sin.

סלח.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √slḥ 'to forgive'. Used only of divine forgiveness.

כפר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √kpr 'to cover, atone'. Source of כפרה, יום כיפור.

שלם.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √šlm 'to be complete, at peace'. Source of שלום, שלם.

תמיד.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √tmd 'to be continuous'. Source of תמיד 'always'.

צפון.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ṣpn 'to hide, north'. Mt. Zaphon was north of Israel.

נגב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ngb 'to be dry, south'. The Negev is the southern desert.

מזרח.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √zrḥ 'to rise, shine'. East = where sun rises.

מערב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ʿrb 'to set, enter'. West = where sun sets.
